Q1 Vendor setup, with Mei Northcott
Walk us through setting up a new vendor.

I enter the vendor from the W-9 and the Controller approves the record. When she is out I approve it myself so the job is not held up; that happened for Marten Lake Aggregates LLC, Rainier Site Supply LLC, Sound Formwork Rentals LLC. The portal lets me approve payments under $25,000.
Q2 Payment runs, with Dana Whitfield
How is a payment run approved?

Accounts Payable builds the run and I approve it in the bank portal; the Chief Financial Officer approves anything of $100,000 or more. I did not know the portal let Accounts Payable approve small payments.
Q3 Pay applications, with Brandon Valdivia
How is a pay application prepared and approved?
I prepare it from the schedule of values and the percent complete, the owner’s architect reviews it, and the Controller approves it before it is sent. Retainage is 5% on every job.
Q4 Rate changes, with Renata Salazar
How is a pay rate changed?

From a signed personnel action form. I enter every change. My own raise was agreed in my review with the President and CEO, but I entered it before she signed the form. The payroll system can print a master file change report; we do not run it.
Q5 Payroll release, with Dana Whitfield
What do you review before releasing a payroll?
The register totals against the prior payroll, headcount and overtime. I do not see changes to rates or bank accounts unless they move the totals.
Q6 Journal entries, with Dana Whitfield
Who reviews your journal entries over $25,000?
The policy says the Chief Financial Officer, but in practice I post my own entries at month end and nobody reviews them. I review the Project Accountant’s entries.
Q7 Bank reconciliations, with Marisol Zielinski
How is the bank reconciliation done and reviewed?
I reconcile the operating account each month within two weeks and give it to the Controller. She looks at it but has not been signing it.
Q8 User access, with Dana Whitfield
When were system permissions last reviewed?
When the bank portal was set up in 2023. I have not reviewed them since.
